Whether you're jetting off to the tropics or staying closer to home, these Birdsong Sandals are a must. They're crafted from a tonal mix of raffia and supple leather in a versatile brown shade. Zoom in to appreciate the exuberant, texture-rich motif, handwoven by artisans in Colombia.
